Hi Braden Dennis & Simon Belanger — The Canadian Investor,

I recently reviewed your release "SpaceX Growth Explodes, Netflix’s Slowdown & BlackRock’s Big Warning" (https://omny.fm/shows/the-canadian-investor/spacex-growth-explodes-netflix-s-slowdown-blackrock-s-big-warning) and noted your public production context: Public content/repurposing workflow need (backlog, turnaround, weekly): "Despite.

IncuBrix provides confirmed Long-Form to Short-Form Repurposing Workflow and Editing & Captioning Assistance designed specifically for Podcaster / Video Podcaster teams publishing 12+ recent items—helping turn long-form recordings into captioned vertical clips and multi-channel posts while keeping editorial quality intact.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute walkthrough using "SpaceX Growth Explodes, Netflix’s Slowdown & BlackRock’s Big Warning" as a test case?

Best regards,
Arjun Mehta (Growth Engineering Candidate) — Independent Growth Assessment Participant (evaluating IncuBrix workflows)
No worries if not relevant—happy to never follow up if you prefer.
